rows.definition: The scorecard debt-integer key for the git-daily health card: the string "git_daily_debt" under which the card publishes its count of health lenses scoring below the pass line.
rows.distinction: Not the generic per-scorecard *_debt integer concept (x2-score-debt-debtintegers) and not a named scorecard surface (x2-score-debt-scorecardvariants): this is one concrete card's key constant, the argument the git-daily renderer passes to scorecard.Render to select which integer heads the work-list.

rows.definition: metrics.GitDailyHealthFragment renders a graded git-daily payload and its ledger-derived counts as one deterministic operator line: grade, runs, outcomes, folded objects, refusal streak, and GitDailyDebtKey debt.
rows.distinction: It emits the compact git-daily status fragment from an already-graded payload. It is not scorecard.Render, which emits a generic multi-line work list, and not GradeGitDailyHealth, which computes the grade and debt.
